risks.current: Canonical contracts exist without a generic operational Order or Payment writer.
risks.impact: New products can create competing transaction authorities.
risks.requiredClosure: Freeze instance contracts and one write owner before new checkout work.

risks.current: Stripe identifiers and errors are embedded in API and D1 schema.
risks.impact: A second provider would require branching canonical logic or schema duplication.
risks.requiredClosure: Introduce provider-neutral adapter and normalized event envelope.

risks.current: Migration 0004 hard-codes Book I, MYR and amount 8900.
risks.impact: It cannot safely represent Journey, membership or professional transactions.
risks.requiredClosure: Design additive generic commercial storage; preserve 0004 unchanged.

risks.current: Book entitlement activation is product-specific while generic Entitlement has no operational owner.
risks.impact: Copying Book activation would let payment bypass formal Journey gates.
risks.requiredClosure: Implement product-specific activation policies under one Entitlement owner.

risks.current: Approved amount is embedded in Offer metadata; no standalone versioned Price or order snapshot exists.
risks.impact: Historical commercial terms cannot be independently audited across offer changes.
risks.requiredClosure: Freeze Price version and immutable order-term snapshot.

risks.current: Book refund is an aggregate update; Credit and Settlement do not exist.
risks.impact: Partial refunds, provider reconciliation and accounting lineage are incomplete.
risks.requiredClosure: Create append-only refund, credit and settlement facts with reconciliation rules.

risks.current: Book operational data has no declared cutover/backfill to future canonical commercial instances.
risks.impact: Dual writes or identity loss could duplicate payment and entitlement facts.
risks.requiredClosure: Freeze idempotent bridge, backfill, comparison and rollback plan before migration.

risks.current: 18 planned offers coexist with only two approved canonical offers.
risks.impact: Planning presence may be mistaken for purchasable production scope.
risks.requiredClosure: Require explicit approval and canonical registration before checkout exposure.

risks.current: Appointment payment record is a bounded in-memory contract without verified settlement.
risks.impact: Consumers may misread a record projection as confirmed payment.
risks.requiredClosure: Project only from canonical verified Payment facts; preserve gateway-disabled status until then.

risks.current: Account, subscription and entitlement states are client preview only.
risks.impact: Client state could be promoted accidentally to authority.
risks.requiredClosure: Keep preview fields non-authoritative and read from canonical services after implementation.

risks.current: Receipt persistence and formatting are Book-specific.
risks.impact: Other products lack a uniform immutable commercial receipt lineage.
risks.requiredClosure: Define receipt ownership and projection from canonical order/payment facts.

risks.current: Latest main precheck expects 12 registry audit files but observes 13.
risks.impact: Full regression suite cannot reach later checks, including this audit.
risks.requiredClosure: Repair the stale count in its owning baseline work without altering Registry authority.
